cats.name: Orchestrators & Multi-Agent
cats.blurb: Running several agents at once, or one agent for a long time: swarms, loop runners, task queues, planners and the orchestration write-ups.

cats.name: Coding Agents
cats.blurb: The agent you point at a repository. Terminal, desktop and web, plus the parallel-agent front-ends built on top of them.

cats.name: Agent Skills
cats.blurb: Capability bundles an agent loads on demand — SKILL.md packages, subagents, slash commands, and the directories that collect them.

cats.name: MCP Servers
cats.blurb: The Model Context Protocol ecosystem: reference and third-party servers, inspectors, gateways, transports, and the sibling agent-to-agent protocols.

cats.name: Frameworks & SDKs
cats.blurb: Libraries you build an agent out of, and the tool-calling interfaces it reaches the world through.

cats.name: Harnesses & Runtime Infra
cats.blurb: The scaffolding around the model rather than the model or the agent: runtimes, providers, gateways, fine-tuning, and what a harness runs on in production.

cats.name: Context, Memory & RAG
cats.blurb: Everything that decides what the model actually sees: retrieval, memory stores, compaction, and the chat-with-your-data apps built on them.

cats.name: Sandbox, Security & Governance
cats.blurb: Isolation, permissions, approval gates, guardrails, compliance and audit — plus the security agents that attack and defend.

cats.name: Observability & Evals
cats.blurb: Traces, benchmarks, graders, linting and CI feedback: how you find out whether the agent actually did the thing.

cats.name: Plugins, Themes & Clients
cats.blurb: Attaches to an agent you already run — plugins, themes, status lines, alternative clients, notification bridges and generative UIs.

cats.name: Research & Data Agents
cats.blurb: Agents pointed at literature, the web and datasets: deep research, analysis, business intelligence and science.

cats.name: Creative, Voice & Media
cats.blurb: Image, audio, video, voice and prose agents, and the ones that play games.

cats.name: Assistants & Domain Agents
cats.blurb: One agent doing one job in one domain: support, sales, finance, health, travel, browser and desktop automation, personal assistants.

cats.name: Docs, Learning & Lists
cats.blurb: Reading rather than running: guides, courses, pattern write-ups, practice postures, and the other awesome-lists this one was merged from.
